entities.summary: St. Peter's Cathedral is an interdenominational church in Bautzen, Germany. It is among the oldest and largest simultaneum churches in Germany. Located in the heart of the city's "Old Town", the church and the square it is situated within is a major tourist attraction. Cathedral of St Peter, Bautzen is a cathedral in Europe, established in 1213. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
